scope: Production and support contracts for the portable Windows inspection package. The external portability receipt binds the actual tested contents and launches.

guides.text:
# KingdomZombies resource inspection

Use the Windows inspection package to browse the production resource library. The package opens in the Inspection hub. Start with Items or choose Characters, Buildings/world, UI, Data/text or Audio. Register lists the 180 required asset entries. The startup selection shows the retained `common.bow` resource. Choose `IT-07` in Items for the completed Bow preview. [Windows inspection and launch guide](windows-inspection.md)

The summary shows the selected ID, name and status. Use **Show details** for provenance and editing data. For an unavailable resource, preserve the exact ID, path, field and reason with **Copy details**. Open another entry to continue inspecting, then use **Recheck resources** after restoring the required bytes.

## Content reference

| View | Content |
| --- | --- |
| DT-18 | Designer field reference and configurable defaults |
| DT-19 | Source, version, provenance and delivery bindings |
| DT-20–DT-23 | Animation and fitting, world assembly, native layouts and sound event libraries |
| DT-26 | Saved fixture and scenario catalog |
| DT-27 | Windows package and source guides |
| TXT-01 and TXT-02 | English messages and an expanded-text inspection fixture |

The production references explain how to edit definitions and trace them to the source assets. Retained authoring bundles hold recovered source material, recorded recipes, masters and prompts. [Production contracts](production.md) · [Designer fields](fields.md) · [Asset and resource plan](../../specs/0.1/assets-and-resources.md)

# Windows inspection and evidence

## Launch the portable package

Copy or extract the entire portable folder to a writable directory. Keep `KingdomZombies.exe`, `KingdomZombies.pck` and `data_KingdomZombies_windows_x86_64` together. The folder supplies the Godot executable, self-contained .NET runtime and the current content pack.

1. Open `KingdomZombies.exe` from that folder. The `asset_inspection` feature selects the Inspection hub. Use 1280×720 for the Phase 4 Windows review session.
2. Wait for **Validated; visual/listening acceptance pending**. The hub shows the current pack count. Select `IT-07` in Items to inspect the Bow.
3. Use the window close button and wait for the process to exit. Open the same executable from the same folder and check the same resource again.

For a headless launch and natural exit, run the following command from the portable folder in PowerShell.

```powershell
.\KingdomZombies.exe --headless --quit-after 360
```

## Build and verify

From the repository root, run the complete export group and the portability case with the pinned Windows tools. The portability case writes the retained folder path, file hashes, fresh launch and relaunch identities, exact missing-resource and valid-sibling observations, and runtime-resolution evidence to `portable-delivery.json` in its run directory. Use that identified folder for the focused review and acceptance. [Development setup](../workflow/setup.md) · [Phase 4 evidence handoff](../../.planning/phases/04-asset-production/04-HANDOFF.md)

```powershell
node src/godot-game/tools/asset-pipeline/check.cjs --group export
node src/godot-game/tools/asset-pipeline/check.cjs --case export.portability
```

The export uses the permanent **Phase4 Windows inspection** preset and the authenticated official Godot 4.7.2 .NET Windows template. Runtime content includes the English catalog, the supporting documentation, fonts, audio, layouts and exact indexed data from the game project. The Windows executable uses the official template metadata. The game application title and icon are part of the project and packaged resources.

For source inspection, open the pinned Godot .NET project and run `inspection/Inspection.tscn` as the current scene. The ordinary project launch opens Foundation. The portability receipt records headless Windows results. Actual Windows input, appearance, readability, listening and judgments follow independent review. Linux execution has a separate platform owner. [Resource inspection index](README.md)

# Godot integration reference

The existing Godot launch target composes Core and service ports. Its small native proof scene exercises engine-owned construction, resources, exported values, generated partials, signals, main-thread access and repeated teardown. These are development proofs; menus, movement and LAN remain later-phase work.

[Project](../KingdomZombies.csproj) · [Executable project policy](../../tools/verification/projects.json) · [Native fixture](../proofs/Phase1.cs) · [Code index](../../../../docs/code/README.md)

## Resource inspection

The Godot project contains production resources and inspection fixtures. The ordinary project launch opens Foundation for solo and LAN. The Windows inspection export opens the resource hub through the `asset_inspection` feature.

For source inspection, run `inspection/Inspection.tscn` as the current scene. In a portable Windows folder, launch `KingdomZombies.exe` beside `KingdomZombies.pck` and `data_KingdomZombies_windows_x86_64`. Close the window and relaunch the same executable to repeat an inspection.

Use Characters, Items, Buildings/world, UI, Data/text or Audio. Register lists all 180 required IDs. The summary shows the current ID, name and status. Use **Show details** and **Copy details** to capture exact resource information. For a missing resource, record its ID, path, field and reason, open a valid sibling and use **Recheck resources** after restoring the missing bytes.

In Data/text, DT-18 opens the designer fields, DT-19–DT-23 open the production libraries, DT-26 lists the saved fixtures and DT-27 opens the Windows guides. TXT-01 provides the English catalog and TXT-02 provides expanded text for inspection. [Content index](../content/pack-index.json) · [English catalog](../content/text/en.json) · [Delivery crosswalk](../content/packs/delivery.json) · [Designer fields](../content/packs/text-data.json)

The portability receipt records the headless package result. Phase 4's focused Windows review records the final appearance, input, readability and listening evidence. Linux execution follows separate platform verification.

## Reference declaration

The two direct production references implement composition. Godot SDK packages supply engine APIs. The separate analyzer build edge must retain both metadata values.

```project-policy
{"project":"src/godot-game/game/KingdomZombies.csproj","policy":"src/godot-game/tools/verification/projects.json","productionReferences":["src/godot-game/core/KingdomZombies.Core.csproj","src/godot-game/multiplayer-abstractions/KingdomZombies.Multiplayer.Abstractions.csproj"],"inspectionReferences":[],"analyzerReference":{"path":"src/godot-game/tools/code-rules/Sebreiro.CodeRules.Analyzers.csproj","OutputItemType":"Analyzer","ReferenceOutputAssembly":"false"}}
```
